_comment: Known WCAG 2.1 AA violations in OrangeHRM 5.9, measured with axe-core 4.14 on 2026-10-30 after network idle (all widgets loaded). Tests fail only on rules NOT listed here. Remove a rule once it is fixed so it can't come back. Dashboard image-alt and scrollable-region-focusable come from widgets that load late, so they were only found once scans waited for network idle.
